lower_pyramids.prime_atomic: primes, local Euler factors, Frobenius/local identities
lower_pyramids.prime_derived: prime powers, von Mangoldt weights, logarithmic derivatives, cutoffs, heat/character transforms
lower_pyramids.completed_coupling: endpoint-gamma-prime combination, Mellin-Poisson normalization, completed even distribution rho

identity_index: alpha ranges over parallel source-derived routes F_alpha,G_alpha in and between lower pyramids
probe_index: p ranges over heat jets (k,t) and fixed-width finite translate Gram probes
joint_faithfulness: if all C_(p,alpha)=0 and the observer family is jointly faithful, then every compared source route agrees
positivity_output: P_p(x) asserts the probe value lies in its positive cone
metaobject: the conformance equalizer intersected with the observer positivity cone
separation: conformance and positivity are independent coordinates; neither implies the other
hostile: the even signed distribution rho_-=-(delta_1+delta_-1)/2 satisfies all heat-derivative and heat-character coherence identities but has negative scalar heat values and negative Gram diagonals
no_regress: the metaobserver is a limit/equalizer specification over the product index category, not a new source of evidence or another lower pyramid
acceptance_test: Construct one source-derived transformation from the completed coupled apex into the intersection of the conformance equalizer and positivity cone, uniformly over every identity and observer index.
